title: PACT Push Subscription Create Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/{resourceId}/subscriptions. A subscription delivers only events the subscribing principal is entitled to observe — 17.13 applies to the pushed payload exactly as it applies to a read. Push is not a disclosure bypass. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 21.2).

endpoint.description: Absolute https URL. Implementations MUST reject non-https and SHOULD reject endpoints resolving to private address ranges unless explicitly configured otherwise.

event_types.description: Section 6.2 event types to deliver. MUST be non-empty — a subscription MUST NOT be a wildcard for every event type an implementation might later add.

secret_hint.description: Opaque key identifier the subscriber echoes in its verification tooling. Not a secret itself.
